summary: GeoGuessr entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: GeoGuessr

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Desktop browser capture of current service

primary.why: GeoGuessr is a live geography game whose official site remains the main account, mode, and content route. Steam and mobile versions are useful access routes, but the web service is the authority for the long-running game.
primary.how_to_play: Use GeoGuessr.com in a desktop browser. Record account/subscription state, map/mode, ruleset, date, and whether the capture is solo, challenge, party, or ranked play.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service modes and map pools change. Record mode, date, account/subscription state, and whether Steam/mobile was used.
